info.name: Returns all metrics mapped to the given `tag_id`.

params.name: tag_id
params.description: A unique numerical id assigned to each tag, which returns all metrics mapped to that tag.

params.name: offset
params.description: Specify the starting point for the results returned. Permitted values are integers greater than or equal to 0. The default value is 0.

params.name: limit
params.description: The number of tags returned per page. Permitted values are integers greater than or equal to 0. The default value is 15.

items.docs: Returns all metrics mapped to the given `tag_id`.

info.name: Returns all key result tags in the system and allows for filtering tags by parameters.

params.name: id
params.description: Optional. A unique numerical id assigned to each tag. Include this parameter to return attributes of the specified tag only; otherwise all tags will be returned.

params.name: status
params.description: 1 for Active, 2 archived. Include the status parameter in the request to limit the response of tags with a particular status.

params.name: group_id
params.description: A numeric value for filtering tags available in the specific Tag group.

params.name: limit
params.description: The number of tags returned per page. Permitted values are integers greater than or equal to 0. The default value is 15.

params.name: offset
params.description: Specify the starting point for the results returned. Permitted values are integers greater than or equal to 0. The default value is 0.

items.docs: Returns all key result tags in the system and allows for filtering tags by parameters.
